technology_name: GROUND GRANULATED BLAST FURNACE SLAG-DOLOMITE GEOPOLYMER CONCRETE BLOCKS
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Traditional Portland cement block manufacturing emits substantial carbon dioxide and consumes high-energy resources, lacking sustainability.
description: An eco-friendly geopolymer concrete block formulation incorporating ground granulated blast furnace slag (GGBS) and dolomite as binder sources mixed with aggregates and an alkaline solution activator.
applications: Carbon-neutral building construction, green infrastructure blocks, low-cost load-bearing masonry walls, and sustainable paving stones.
